# NGD Solutions — NextGenDev Solutions

> NGD Solutions is the short name for NextGenDev Solutions. It is a remote-first digital solutions agency serving businesses in India and worldwide, with a separate practical mentorship track for students.

## Entity and contact
- Canonical website: https://ngdsolutions.com/
- Brand aliases: NGD Solutions, NGDSolutions, NextGenDev, NextGenDev Solutions, NextGenDevSolutions
- Services: websites and web platforms, mobile apps, AI and workflow automation, brand identity and UI/UX, SEO and content systems, digital marketing and funnels
- Student track: final-year project architecture, code reviews, portfolios and internship readiness
- Email: hello@ngdsolutions.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94659 38126
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm IST
- Location model: remote-first; India and worldwide

## Starting-price context (INR)
- Focused landing page: ₹5,000–₹10,000
- Small business website: ₹10,000–₹25,000
- Website with CMS: ₹20,000–₹40,000
- Custom web application: ₹30,000+
- Maintenance: ₹1,000–₹5,000/month
Final scope, price and timeline are confirmed in writing before work starts.

## Important clarification
NGD does not guarantee Google rankings, AI citations, revenue, grades or advertising returns. Student support is mentorship and code guidance, not a way to bypass academic responsibility.
